n9ec1237467.headline: Risky home loans capped amid 'runaway' investor growth
n9ec1237467.summary: A pick-up in riskier forms of home lending has prompted a regulator to set limits on high debt-to-income loans. The move follows what the article describes as runaway investor growth.
n9ec1237467.why: The Australian Prudential Regulation Authority supervises banks, and lending limits affect bank mortgage growth and housing demand.

n8d10826ec7.headline: Zipline in talks with gov't over GH¢174m arrears to sustain services
n8d10826ec7.summary: Zipline Ghana is in discussions with the government to recover outstanding payments exceeding GH¢174 million for 2025. The company says the talks are needed to sustain its services.
n8d10826ec7.why: Zipline is a drone delivery company, and government payment arrears affect its cash flow and ability to keep operating in Ghana.

nd749492daa.headline: UFP Tech UFPT Q3 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
nd749492daa.summary: UFP Technologies held its third-quarter 2025 earnings call, with a transcript published by The Motley Fool. The candidate text provides no financial figures.
nd749492daa.why: UFP Technologies is a US manufacturer of components for medical and other industries, and its quarterly results show demand and margins for investors.

neb901418d1.headline: South Africa’s Partial G20 Success in 2025
neb901418d1.summary: South Africa's G20 presidency highlighted Africa's financial challenges and an urgent need for debt reform, with its success described as partial.
neb901418d1.why: G20 finance agendas shape international debt restructuring and lending frameworks that affect emerging and African sovereign borrowing costs.

ncd1ee8819e.headline: PM Shehbaz hails Pakistan-Bahrain FTA, calls for stronger economic ties
ncd1ee8819e.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif praised the Pakistan-Bahrain free trade agreement and called for stronger economic ties between the two countries.
ncd1ee8819e.why: Free trade agreements reduce tariffs and barriers, shaping bilateral trade flows and investment opportunities for companies in both markets.

n626c319318.headline: IPO storm to hit D st in December with over a dozen issues as Sensex, Nifty hit news highs - BusinessToday
n626c319318.summary: Primary market activity is expected to return to Dalal Street in December with more than a dozen IPOs, as the Sensex and Nifty reach record levels.
n626c319318.why: A busy IPO pipeline signals investor appetite and capital raising activity on India's main stock exchanges in Mumbai.

n665b024a47.headline: Sensex, Nifty hit all-time highs: Is India
n665b024a47.summary: Indian markets hit record highs on Thursday, with the Sensex crossing 86,000 for the first time and the Nifty 50 passing its September 2024 peak.
n665b024a47.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the benchmark indexes of India's National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange, tracking the country's largest listed companies.
n665b024a47.why_moved: Expectations of coordinated rate cuts by the US Federal Reserve and the Reserve Bank of India next month are fuelling the rally, with the prospect of more liquidity.

n3c4021a984.headline: OECD calls on Spain to reform pensions to make them sustainable
n3c4021a984.summary: The OECD called on Spain to reform its pension system to make it sustainable, with this year's pensions requiring a €50 billion fund transfer to cover the deficit.
n3c4021a984.why: Pension sustainability affects Spain's public finances, government borrowing needs and long-term fiscal credibility with investors.

na383ad6d6a.headline: For many, the holidays this year means having to make do with less
na383ad6d6a.summary: Many US households are scrimping this holiday season amid job losses, reduced food benefits and higher prices.
na383ad6d6a.why: Consumer spending drives a large share of US economic activity, so pressure on household budgets matters for retail and growth outlooks.

nd8c8a4eed6.headline: Cisco aims to support creation of cloud data centers in Kazakhstan (Exclusive)
nd8c8a4eed6.summary: US-based Cisco plans to support the creation of cloud data centres based on its technologies in Kazakhstan, according to its Managing Director for Türkiye. The report is an exclusive.
nd8c8a4eed6.why: Cisco is a major networking and security equipment maker, and data-centre build-outs drive demand for its infrastructure products.

nb737b919f0.headline: Minority and Majority in battle over lithium deal
nb737b919f0.summary: Majority and minority parliamentary caucuses disagree over the proposed carried interest in Ghana's lithium agreement with Barari DV Ghana Limited. The majority says the prior 10% proposal deviated from the Minerals and Mining Act, 2010.
nb737b919f0.why: Lithium is a key battery metal, and the carried interest a government takes in a mining project determines its share of resource revenue.

n44dd44f0ad.headline: Economic Activity records a strong outturn in October 2025; consumer confidence surges - BoG
n44dd44f0ad.summary: The Bank of Ghana's Monetary Policy Committee said economic activity recorded a strong outturn in October 2025. Its confidence surveys showed consumer confidence surging and continued optimism.
n44dd44f0ad.why: The central bank's assessment of activity and confidence informs its policy stance, which affects Ghana's interest rates and the cedi.

n53d1a67153.headline: Entire produce of pulses will be procured on MSP, Union Minister Chouhan assures Punjab farmers
n53d1a67153.summary: Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan assured Punjab farmers that the entire produce of tur, urad, lentils and gram will be procured at minimum support price. He spoke in Moga.
n53d1a67153.why: Minimum support prices set a floor for farm incomes and affect government procurement costs and pulses supply in India.

n9d6f876991.headline: Banks remain sound and well capitalised – BoG
n9d6f876991.summary: The Bank of Ghana said banks remain sound and well capitalised. The non-performing loan ratio declined to 19.5% in October 2025 from 22.7% in October 2024.
n9d6f876991.why: Non-performing loan ratios and capital adequacy indicate banking-sector health, which matters for lenders, credit growth and investors in Ghanaian financial stocks.

n56585936cb.headline: China’s CPECC wins contract for Ibri III solar, battery storage project
n56585936cb.summary: China Power Engineering Consulting Group International (CPECC), a Chinese state-owned energy engineering company, has won a contract for the Ibri III solar and battery storage project in Oman.
n56585936cb.why: CPECC is a state-owned Chinese engineering firm that builds large power projects, so its contract wins reflect China's role in international energy infrastructure.

n615cca4cf8.headline: HMRC 'targeting' UK households for £8,165 tax over £50,000 rule change
n615cca4cf8.summary: Financial experts warned that Chancellor Rachel Reeves's Budget changes will drag more people into paying more tax. The reported figure relates to a £50,000 threshold rule change.
n615cca4cf8.why: Changes to UK income tax thresholds set by the Chancellor of the Exchequer affect household disposable income and consumer spending. HM Revenue and Customs administers the tax system.

nac47110208.headline: Ghana’s current account hits US$3.8bn, accounting for cedi stability
nac47110208.summary: The Bank of Ghana's Monetary Policy Committee said the trade surplus rose to US$7.5 billion, driven by surging gold and cocoa export earnings, supporting cedi stability.
nac47110208.why: Ghana is a major gold and cocoa exporter, so commodity prices and export volumes strongly shape its current account and currency.

ncb5b25b7a2.headline: Wipro inks multi year Odido Netherlands deal to revamp IT landscape; stock ends flat - BusinessToday
ncb5b25b7a2.summary: Wipro signed a multi-year deal with Odido Netherlands to overhaul its IT landscape, deploying AI-led platforms and consulting, according to a filing. Wipro's stock ended flat.
ncb5b25b7a2.why: Wipro is an Indian IT services firm whose large multi-year client contracts indicate demand for its digital and AI services.

impacts.name: Wipro
impacts.why: A new multi-year client contract adds to Wipro's engagement pipeline.

n997d98cf97.headline: Celsius (CELH) Q3 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
n997d98cf97.summary: Celsius Holdings (CELH) published the transcript of its third-quarter 2025 earnings call. The input contains no financial figures beyond the transcript title.
n997d98cf97.why: Celsius is a US beverage company known for its energy drinks. Earnings calls give investors management commentary on sales, margins and outlook.

n62ee3680ad.headline: Budget details you might have missed as Rachel Reeves delivered Autumn Statement
n62ee3680ad.summary: Chancellor Rachel Reeves delivered her second Budget as Autumn Statement, with £26bn of tax rises. The package also ends the two-child benefit cap.
n62ee3680ad.why: The UK Budget sets fiscal policy, including taxation and spending, which affects government borrowing, gilt yields and household finances.

ne7e51fe350.headline: Sensex up 111 pts, Nifty flat after hitting new highs; what’s next for stock market? - BusinessToday
ne7e51fe350.summary: The Sensex rose 111 points while the Nifty was flat after both indexes hit new highs. Bajaj Finance led Sensex gainers, up 2.27%, with ICICI Bank rising 1.39%.
ne7e51fe350.why: The Sensex and Nifty 50 are the benchmark equity indexes of India's stock market, tracking large companies listed on the BSE and NSE.

ne7db304f8f.headline: 'Very positive news': ray of light post inflation shock
ne7db304f8f.summary: Equipment investment in Australia's IT sector almost doubled in three months, amid a surge in data-centre projects. The report was described as a bright spot after an inflation shock.
ne7db304f8f.why: Business investment in IT equipment is a component of GDP and signals demand for technology hardware. Data-centre construction is closely tied to AI infrastructure spending.

nfdbb1df06a.headline: 'Very positive news': ray of light post inflation shock
nfdbb1df06a.summary: Equipment investment in Australia's IT sector almost doubled in three months amid a surge in data centre projects.
nfdbb1df06a.why: Business investment in IT and data centres signals demand for technology hardware and digital infrastructure.

na0dd516637.headline: Indians had a crush brewing for a star. But, the love may be fading
na0dd516637.summary: Starbucks India's revenue rose 5% to ₹1,277 crore in FY25, while losses deepened 65% to ₹135.7 crore, with the chain under pressure to fix its high-cost model.
na0dd516637.why: Starbucks India is a joint venture with Tata Consumer, so its results affect the partner's consumer business and the coffee chain's global expansion.

n509d7c8ec4.headline: Tata Realty receives Rs 1,280 crore loan facility from DBS Bank for Gurugram project - BusinessToday
n509d7c8ec4.summary: Tata Realty received a Rs 1,280 crore loan facility from DBS Bank, structured as a green loan, for the Intellion Park office campus in Gurugram.
n509d7c8ec4.why: Tata Realty is a unit of the Tata Group and develops commercial and residential property in India. Green loans link financing costs to environmental standards.

n18186a974c.headline: BioNTech (BNTX) Q3 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
n18186a974c.summary: A transcript of BioNTech's Q3 2025 earnings call has been published. The candidate item contains no further financial details.
n18186a974c.why: BioNTech is a German biotechnology company known for its mRNA vaccine and cancer immunotherapy programmes, so its quarterly results shape investor views of the sector.

nd468791d04.headline: Outlook for Greatech still positive despite softer 3Q results
nd468791d04.summary: Analysts have lowered earnings forecasts for Greatech Technology after weaker-than-expected 3Q25 results. They remain positive on the company's long-term outlook.
nd468791d04.why: Greatech Technology is a Malaysian industrial automation equipment maker, and its results reflect demand from its manufacturing clients.

n4f65dce369.headline: BYD’s FCB Ti7 hits 50,000 sales in 80 days as one of China’s fastest-selling PHEV SUVs
n4f65dce369.summary: BYD's FCB Ti7 plug-in hybrid SUV, sold as the Tai 7, reached 50,000 sales in 80 days. The model is being prepared for overseas sales under the Denza brand.
n4f65dce369.why: BYD is one of the world's largest electric vehicle and plug-in hybrid makers, so its sales momentum and export plans bear on global EV market share.

impacts.name: BYD
impacts.why: Rapid sales of a new model and planned overseas expansion support BYD's volume growth.

nedc5050f43.headline: Apple beats out Samsung for first time in 14 years to become world’s top smartphone seller
nedc5050f43.summary: Apple's 2025 smartphone shipments are expected to top Samsung's for the first time in over a decade, making it the world's leading smartphone seller, according to a new report.
nedc5050f43.why: Apple and Samsung are the two largest smartphone makers, and shifts in their shipment shares affect component suppliers and the premium handset market.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: A new report expects Apple's 2025 smartphone shipments to exceed Samsung's, making Apple the top seller.

n77763e15bc.headline: Cereno Scientific AB Loss At -SEK21.32 Mln In Q3
n77763e15bc.summary: Cereno Scientific AB reported a third-quarter loss of SEK21.32 million, or SEK0.07 per share. The loss compares with a loss of about SEK22 million a year earlier.
n77763e15bc.why: Cereno Scientific is a Swedish clinical-stage biotech company, and its quarterly losses reflect ongoing spending on drug development.

n40d38f7f3b.headline: B.C.’s projected deficit drops slightly to $11.2B, finance minister says
n40d38f7f3b.summary: British Columbia's finance minister Brenda Bailey released the second quarterly report, showing the projected deficit dropping slightly to $11.2 billion. The report notes economic growth of 1.4% in 2025.
n40d38f7f3b.why: Provincial deficits and growth figures shape borrowing costs and bond supply for provincial governments in Canada.

n078f7fecfc.headline: 'A serious mistake': Steven Guilbeault quits Carney’s cabinet over Alberta pipeline deal
n078f7fecfc.summary: Steven Guilbeault has resigned from Prime Minister Mark Carney's cabinet over the Alberta pipeline deal. He is expected to remain in the Liberal caucus.
n078f7fecfc.why: Federal energy policy and pipeline approvals affect investment in Canada's oil sands, export capacity and project financing.

naad9e2acd5.headline: B.C. Premier Eby doesn’t want Alberta’s proposed pipeline to be ‘energy vampire’
naad9e2acd5.summary: Alberta signed a pipeline memorandum of understanding with the federal government on Thursday, November 27. B.C. Premier David Eby said he does not want the pipeline to become an energy vampire on his province.
naad9e2acd5.why: Pipeline memoranda set the framework for new export capacity from Alberta's oil sands, which affects producers, shippers and Canadian crude pricing.

nfc8dde9d36.headline: Trupanion (TRUP) Q3 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
nfc8dde9d36.summary: A transcript of Trupanion's third-quarter 2025 earnings call has been published. The candidate contains only the title, so no results are reported.
nfc8dde9d36.why: Trupanion is a pet insurance company, and its quarterly calls give investors management commentary on subscriber growth and profitability.

n7faac693a8.headline: ICE Canola Futures Firm in Quiet Trade
n7faac693a8.summary: Canola futures on the Intercontinental Exchange held small gains midday Thursday in thin, choppy trade. US markets were closed for Thanksgiving.
n7faac693a8.why: Canola is a major Canadian oilseed crop, and its futures prices affect farm incomes and crushers and exporters of canola oil and meal.
